may_be_looking_for: People with a body mass index between 18 and 32 kg/m²
People with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) diagnosed for at least 6 months and meeting the EULAR/ACR 2019 classification criteria
People with SLE who are taking at least one background therapy for SLE
People with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) diagnosed for at least 6 months and meeting the 2010 ACR-EULAR classification criteria for RA
may_exclude_people_who: Have a known active infection (excluding fungal infection of nail beds)
Have had a major episode of infection requiring hospitalization or treatment with anti-infectives within 8 weeks before dosing
Have a history of serious recurrent or chronic infection
Are known to be infected with hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C virus, or human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
patient_summary: This study looks at a study medicine called MK-1045 in people with lupus and rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The main goal of the study is to learn about the safety of MK-1045 and if people tolerate it when they receive it at different dose levels (amounts).
patient_title: Study of MK-1045 for Lupus or Rheumatoid Arthritis
questions_to_ask_clinician: Does my diagnosis and medical history meet the study criteria?
What are the possible risks of taking MK-1045?
How long will the study last and how many visits are required?
What are the different dose levels being tested?
source_grounding: brief_summary: This study looks at a study medicine called MK-1045 in people with lupus and rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The main goal of the study is to learn about the safety of MK-1045 and if people tolerate it when they receive it at different dose levels (amounts).
conditions: Rheumatoid Arthritis, Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
countries: Belgium, Georgia, Italy, Japan, Moldova, Romania

title: A Clinical Study of MK-1045 in People With Lupus or Rheumatoid Arthritis (MK-1045-004)
uncertainty_notes: This is an early-phase (Phase 1) study. The safety and study outcomes of MK-1045 are not yet fully known.
The study is currently recruiting participants in several countries.
what_researchers_are_studying: Researchers are studying the safety and tolerability of different doses of MK-1045 in people with lupus or rheumatoid arthritis.
